long_biography.plain_text:
CrossHarbor Capital Partners is the platform through which Samuel T. Byrne built his career in commercial-property investing. He co-founded the Boston firm in 1993 and now serves as co-founding partner and co-chairman, helping direct its investment committee, fundraising and strategies spanning equity and property-backed debt. The firm's approach combines financial structuring with active asset management and property turnaround.

Byrne's preparation began with economics at Tufts University, distressed real-estate loan workouts at Fleet Financial Group and consultancy on complex property bankruptcies and financing. He had entered the field even earlier, gaining a real-estate licence at seventeen while helping at his mother's Massachusetts office. CrossHarbor's long-running redevelopment investments in Montana's Big Sky region later became a visible example of his patient, operationally engaged investment style.
